option_A_spec.name: Static Beta-Constraint MVO (Soft Penalty)
option_A_spec.mathematical_form:
max_w  w'alpha_hat - (lambda/2)*w'Sigma*w - gamma_beta*max(0, w'beta - beta_target)^2
subject to:
  sum(w) = 1
  w_i >= 0 (long-only, no_short_legal_kr=true)
  0 <= w_i <= 0.10
  HHI = sum(w^2) <= 0.10
  min_names = 10, max_names = 20
  beta_port = sum(w_i * beta_i)
  beta_target = 0.75
  gamma_beta = 0.5  [soft penalty, Alpha Bootstrap CI justified]

option_C3_spec.name: MRS-Dynamic Beta-Constraint MVO
option_C3_spec.mathematical_form:
beta_target(t) = f(MRS_t-1)
  MRS_t-1 in BULL   (Regime_Score >= 70)  => beta_target = 0.90
  MRS_t-1 in NORMAL (Regime_Score 55-70)   => beta_target = 0.85
  MRS_t-1 in NEUTRAL/CAUTION (40-55)        => beta_target = 0.75
  MRS_t-1 in CRISIS (Regime_Score < 40)    => beta_target = 0.60

PIT C5: MRS_t-1 = unified_regime_signal_daily[Date == prev_rebal_date, Regime_Score]
Objective same as Option A with dynamic beta_target(t)
gamma_beta = 0.5 (same as Option A)
